value.rationale: The exact two-to-three site boundary transition identifies a structural hazard in subsampled smoothness-two Korobov quadrature: two adjacent samples have bounded optimal weights whereas three adjacent samples force diverging signed weights, sharp N-linear worst-case bounded-data sensitivity and N² evaluation-noise variance. This clarifies when the motivating kernel-integration mechanism requires dispersed subset selection, with finite explicit constants and a natural minimal sample-count contrast; not a routine restatement of a numerical Gram condition.
